03

When is it conformant?

  1. Preconditions reproduce the specified boundary.
  2. Action exercises the real behavior.
  3. Assertions exclude the dangerous counterexample.
  4. Evidence remains inspectable and replayable.

Line coverage and similar Phase 0 behavior are supporting signals, not sufficient proof of conformance by themselves.

Speaking order

Replay policy

WP05 · scientific owner

Cue and measure

WP05 · preregistration

Sampling
